package_info.why_malicious: The provided report does not describe a specific malicious package or code. Instead, it discusses the failure of traditional network scanning tools to detect vulnerabilities in open source components (specifically Apache Struts) that led to the Equifax breach. No actual malicious package or code is analyzed in the text.

behavioral_signatures: Exploitation of known vulnerabilities in open source components (e.g., Apache Struts)
Attackers targeting application layer rather than network perimeter
file_indicators: Presence of outdated or vulnerable open source libraries (e.g., struts2-core-2.3.15.1.jar)
network_indicators: Unusual outbound traffic following exploitation of application vulnerabilities
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Implement software composition analysis (SCA) tools to identify and alert on the use of vulnerable open source components within applications. Monitor for the presence of outdated libraries and correlate with public vulnerability disclosures. Traditional network scanning tools are insufficient for this purpose.
